name: List contact lists
description: List contact lists with id, name, contact count and parent folder id. Use to find a list id before adding contacts or targeting a campaign.

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page only; behavior from outside a browser (CSRF, CORS, session expiry) was not tested.

verification.notes: Observed in UI traffic, then replayed from inside the logged-in page. A new account already has system lists ('Your first list', 'identified_contacts').

alternative_executions.auth: API key in the api-key header. Not included here.
